assessment.why: Artie has the clearest documented personal loss, but neither murder nor culprit-specific physical action is established. Missing historical poison and separate toast suggest a possible future mechanism.

plausibility_notes: Original poison is missing after forced entry; Grant's emptied claim conflicts with auction condition but his knowledge is unresolved.
Gift bottles distributed to everyone weaken any bottle-color inference.
Canceled blackout and donor-requested camera outage should not be conflated.
